comparisons.comparison: Both C and BAC disclose impacts on Fixed Income revenues, but the nature of the events differs significantly. C reports organic revenue changes in Fixed Income Markets driven by product mix (spread products up, rates/currencies down). BAC reports a specific $1.6 billion charge in 'Market making and similar activities' due to the cessation of the BSBY index, which impacted its Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities (FICC) trading revenue. Unlike C's operational performance drivers, BAC's figure is dominated by a one-time structural charge related to an index discontinuation, making the comparability limited to the FICC/Market Making umbrella rather than direct revenue driver comparison.
